title: PhoenixNest-Video: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Agent Framework for Automated Video Interview Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2609.02231v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interview assessment requires per-criterion judgments grounded in behavioral evidence, yet surging applicant volumes have made human-only evaluation costly and inconsistent, while existing AI approaches yield opaque scores without traceable rationale. We introduce PhoenixNest-Video, an evidence-grounded multimodal agent framework for automated video interview assessment. It builds a semantic video graph as structured working memory, performs rubric-conditioned retrieval with cross-modal verification across visual, audio, and textual streams, and produces per-criterion scores anchored to the candidate's materials. A Scorer trained via Rubrics-based Reinforcement Learning with dual rewards for rubric alignment and score-level differentiation internalizes the discriminative structure of multi-level rubrics. translated_title: PhoenixNest-Video：基于证据的多模态智能体框架用于自动化视频面试评估
translated_abstract: 面试评估需要基于行为证据针对各项评分标准作出判断，然而激增的求职者数量使得仅依赖人工评估成本高昂且标准不一，而现有的人工智能方法则给出缺乏可追溯依据的不透明分数。我们提出了PhoenixNest-Video，一个用于自动化视频面试评估的基于证据的多模态智能体框架。该框架构建语义视频图作为结构化工作记忆，在视觉、音频和文本流之间执行基于评分规则的检索并进行跨模态验证，并生成锚定于候选人材料的逐项标准评分。一个通过基于评分规则的强化学习训练的评分器，借助评分规则对齐和分数区分度的双重奖励，内化了多级评分规则的判别结构。PhoenixNest-Video在VInterview-2025数据集上达到91.50%的等级准确率，显著优于规模大得多的专有模型。
tldr: PhoenixNest-Video是一个基于证据的多模态智能体框架，通过语义视频图工作记忆、跨模态检索验证和基于评分规则的强化学习，实现了可追溯、可解释的自动化视频面试评估，在VInterview-2025上达到91.50%的等级准确率并超越更大的专有模型。
en_tdlr: PhoenixNest-Video is an evidence-grounded multimodal agent framework that achieves traceable automated video interview assessment via semantic video graph working memory, cross-modal rubric-conditioned retrieval, and rubrics-based reinforcement learning, attaining 91.50% grade-level accuracy on VInterview-2025 and outperforming substantially larger proprietary models.
